metadata.description: Prime familiars created by combining 3 base familiars from different categories

skill.name: Blazing Fortress
skill.description: Creates a fiery defensive barrier that reflects 30% damage and burns attackers

skill.name: Tidal Surge
skill.description: Summons a massive wave that deals 250% water damage and slows enemies by 40%

skill.name: Cyclone Strike
skill.description: Executes rapid wind-enhanced strikes dealing 180% damage 5 times in 2 seconds

skill.name: Stone Prison
skill.description: Encases enemies in stone, stunning them for 5 seconds and reducing their defense by 50%

skill.name: Shadow Immolation
skill.description: Becomes intangible while dealing continuous fire damage in a large area

skill.name: Frozen Aegis
skill.description: Conjures a shield of ice that absorbs 500% of max HP as damage and freezes nearby enemies

skill.name: Tempest Harvest
skill.description: Sweeps through enemies with a wind-empowered scythe, dealing 300% damage and healing for 20% of damage dealt

skill.name: Seismic Spear
skill.description: Slams the ground with massive force, creating shockwaves that deal 280% damage and knock back enemies

skill.name: Arcane Inferno
skill.description: Channels powerful flame magic dealing 400% damage over 6 seconds with a 30% chance to cause burn

skill.name: Torrent Cleave
skill.description: Delivers a devastating water-enhanced strike that deals 350% damage and applies a stacking vulnerability debuff

skill.name: Wind Barrier
skill.description: Summons a protective vortex that deflects projectiles and grants 50% evasion for 8 seconds

skill.name: Meteor Wand
skill.description: Calls down rocks from above dealing 320% earth damage in a wide area

skill.name: Piercing Flames
skill.description: Launches a flaming spear that pierces all enemies in a line, dealing 260% damage

skill.name: Shadowy Depths
skill.description: Cloaks the area in watery darkness, reducing enemy accuracy by 40% and dealing 150% damage per second

skill.name: Cyclone Channeling
skill.description: Creates a sustained wind vortex around the familiar, dealing 200% damage per second to nearby enemies

skill.name: Earthen Harvest
skill.description: Swings a massive earth-empowered scythe in a circle, dealing 290% damage and restoring 15% HP
